title: Fully self-sufficient and sustainable living · Soleva Website
h2: Smart living without compromising on comfort #
Our project applies the concept of Low-Tech and the re-use of components to provide a low-carbon and zero-waste habitat. Being comfortable while respecting the planetary limits. #
paragraphs: home > Solar electric van > Sustainable habitat Smart living without compromising on comfort # Our eco-friendly yet comfortable living space does not lack any of the key elements of a home: bedroom, bathroom, kitchen and living room. But the key difference are the materials used. A maximum of low-tech and smart solutions are integrated such as a recirculating shower to reduce water consumption, a composting toilet, an inertial mass stove for heating and more.
The environmental impact of our living space is reduced to a minimum by using plant-based, reused and recycled materials such as cork and wool for insulation and reclaimed wood for the furniture.
